underlines.text: he always attached himself to Elizabeth for the pleasure of talking of her

reference.text: They shook hands with great cordiality; and then, till her sister came down, she had to listen to all he had to say of his own happiness, and of Jane’s perfections; and in spite of his being a lover, Elizabeth really believed all his expectations of felicity to be rationally founded, because they had for basis the excellent understanding and super-excellent disposition of Jane, and a general similarity of feeling and taste between her and himself.

underlines.text: It must have been his sisters’ doing.

reference.text: of all his sister’s falsehood and contrivance!
